entries.text: The pirate camp lies on the coast of Jarkendar, a valley on Khorinis cut off from the rest of the island. The pirates live in huts behind a wooden palisade, fish, hunt and drink. Strangers are rare; newcomers must prove themselves.
Greg is the captain. He was away for a long time on business near the city of Khorinis and has only just come back. While he was gone, Francis was in charge.
Francis ran the camp while Greg was away. Many pirates think he was a poor leader who favoured himself.
The pirates' ship is gone; they cannot simply sail away. Everyone grumbles about it.
Bandits led by Raven occupy a camp further inside Jarkendar. They trade with the pirates sometimes but nobody trusts them. Pirates never go near their camp without reason.
Samuel distils the camp's grog. Grog is rum mixed with water; pirates drink it at every occasion. Greg's favourite tankard is a heavy pewter one with a dent and a carved anchor.
Khorinis is an island in the kingdom of Myrtana. The city is controlled by paladins of the king. The pirates avoid them.
